# Top of Mind

> Research-first marketing studio in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, run by Iulian Huian and Sebastian Răzeșu (TOM BUREAU SRL). Meta and Google Ads, websites and SEO, social media and lead generation, planned around how a business's customers buy: by quote, by cart or by calendar.

## Pages
- [Home](https://topofmind.me/): what the studio does and how it works
- [How you sell](https://topofmind.me/how-you-sell.html): the three buying modes and what we build for each
- [Services](https://topofmind.me/services.html): paid advertising, websites & SEO, social media, lead generation, tracking
- [Process](https://topofmind.me/process.html): the three-step method and the first month, week by week
- [Team](https://topofmind.me/team.html): the two founders
- [Contact](https://topofmind.me/contact.html): booking, WhatsApp, email and FAQ
